The correct answer is K. P. S. Menon, who served as India's Ambassador to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was Ambassador to the USSR from 1949 to 1952 as well—he held the post concurrently in that period before becoming Vice President. The note is therefore not wrong about Radhakrishnan, but Menon is the figure usually cited for that tenure.
CONFIDENCE: 75
